newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Creditors approve S.Korea Kia bailout until Sept 2.
newsitem.headline: Creditors approve S.Korea Kia bailout until Sept 2.

text.p: Creditors to South Korea's struggling Kia Group have approved a bailout until September 29, a Korea First Bank official said on Monday.
"Heads of the creditor banks have confirmed an earlier decision to keep Kia Group afloat until September 29," the official told reporters.
He said the creditors were now discussing whether to extend emergency loans to the group.

The creditors met at 0600 GMT for the third time after two meetings last week ended without a decision. Creditors deemed Kia Group's self-rescue efforts insufficient and said they wanted the resignations of the top Kia executives.
Kia Group was put under the protection of its creditor banks on July 15 after they determined Kia would default on debt payments.
